snippet.title: Rooftops & Alleys - Console Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
🎮  Play the Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703850/Rooftops__Alleys_The_Parkour_Game/
🎮  Wishlist on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013315
🎮  Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/rooftops-alleys-the-parkour-game/9p55kht5533x

Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 launches on consoles and PC June 17th, 2025!
